value.rationale: A complete two-versus-four structural classification (exactly 3 or 4) gives a sharp order-independent result for all complete multipartite graphs, whereas the 2026 introductory general bound depends on n and gamma_L. Its twin-constraint vertex-cover projection explains precisely why configurations with triple twins force only three blocks and supplies constructions for all equality cases. Infinite natural family and structural obstruction are substantive rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
